en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a grand exterior staircase (Freitreppe) in a landscaped park. Manicured conical shrubs line the path leading to the broad steps, which are flanked by ornate stone balustrades and lampposts. Several people walk or push a pram along the path and up the stairs. Dense trees frame the scene, and a monument-like structure stands at the top of the staircase. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image.
